33. If the disabled person is speaking English as a second or third language, there may be
additional barriers to communication, which may in turn affect the nature of the adjustment
under consideration. (See “Interpreters” in chapter 8.)
Adjustments for case preparation

34. The following adjustments in the way pre-trial communication takes place may be
appropriate according to the needs of the individual in question:
• Simplifying wording of correspondence or court orders; if necessary, departing from
standard forms.
• Providing documents/guidance leaflets in Easy Read format, if available. Many of these
are used in the criminal justice system.
